thesis: The setup is a chase of a dividend-news spike in a risk-off tape. Reward/risk is only about 1.1 to the 52-week high, and price sits about 8% above SMA20 after an ~11% five-day run. A special dividend of about $1.95 per ADS (roughly 14% of price) has no ex-date in the packet, so a mechanical drop could hit the 12.45 stop before any thesis plays out. Earnings on 2026-11-27 fall inside the holding window, and the regime is risk-off (QQQ below its 200-day, VIX percentile 0.905, 10-year yield at a 1-year high), which hurts a consumer growth ADR. The spike has already started to fade, with two lower closes after the 14.37 peak.
